One standard 52-card deck (no jokers), four players at the table.

top_apps.name: Junglee Rummy Master
top_apps.description_short: Junglee Rummy Master: Draw, meld sets or runs, discard—empty your hand.
top_apps.description_excerpt:
This is a simulation game intended for entertainment purposes only.

For users aged 18 and over.

This game does not involve real-money gambling and does not offer any opportunity to win real money, cash prizes, or real-world rewards.

All virtual coins, chips, credits, bonuses, and rewards are fictional and can only be used within the game.

No purchases or gameplay outcomes can be exchanged for money or items of value.

Success in this simulation game does not imply future success in real-money gambling.

【How to play】
One standard 52-card deck (no jokers), four players at the table.

Each player starts with 7 cards. The rest form the stock; one card opens the discard pile.

On your turn, draw from the stock or take the top discard.
After drawing, you may lay melds from your hand:
• Set: 3–4 cards of the same rank
• Run: 3+ consecutive cards of the same suit

End every turn by discarding exactly one card.
The first player to empty their hand wins the round and scores the deadwood left in opponents’ hands (A=1, face cards=10, others face value).
First to 100 practice points wins the match.
